name: Assertion Failure
description: Test failed due to an incorrect expected value or assertion mismatch.

name: Locator / Element Not Found
description: Test failed because a UI element could not be found within the timeout.

name: Navigation / Page Load Failure
description: Test failed because the browser could not navigate to or load the target page.

name: Dialog / Alert Handling Error
description: Test failed while interacting with a browser alert, confirm, or prompt dialog.

name: Page / Browser Closed
description: The page or browser context was closed unexpectedly during a test step.
messageRegex: .*Target page, context or browser has been closed.*

name: Product Defect
description: The application returned unexpected data or behavior (confirmed functional defect).
